items.titolo: OpenAI says ChatGPT Sol helped uncover critical PHP flaws that could affect 70% of websites
items.descrizione: OpenAI says researchers using GPT-5.6 Sol uncovered two critical PHP vulnerabilities with severity scores of 9.2 and demonstrated working exploits, after which the company coordinated fixes.
